metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for trace lifecycle management (initialize, update metadata, finalize traces) in agent debugging workflows. It does not semantically match existing skills: the OpenTelemetry skill targets Flink LocalStreamEnvironment setup (different domain/asset), and the Parallel Task Completion skill targets DataStream transformations (different task_family). Peer candidates (Agent Performance Dashboard Navigation, AgentOps Session Lifecycle, Start Trace with Context) are related but operate at different granularities or cover different aspects (dashboard inspection, AgentOps monitoring, single trace initialization). This candidate covers the complete trace lifecycle with metadata enrichment—a capability not present in the registry. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap validates the tracer API contract.
